== Summary ==
Identified: [[Tom Haid]] (left foreground, plaid shirt and black mask) and [[Matt Scott]] (back right, Adidas jacket). Standing figure behind unlabeled.
A player during a match. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]]

* '''Photographer:''' [[Brandon Baity]] ("Here are most of the pictures I took during the weekend", forum post 1356914)
* '''Image:''' native forum attachment, 4592×2584 (full size; replaced an earlier 2400 px copy on 22 November 2026).
